Introduction. Ticks are aggressive creatures found in the Mistlands. Ticks look like giant versions of their namesakes. Their only attack is to latch onto their target and deal constant damage.

Attach. Ticks attach themselves to the player and suck blood from them every 0.5 seconds (50 Pierce damage). This lasts 5 seconds, dealing damage ten times; parrying the attack forces them to detach. Each attack reaches 1 meter in a 40-degree horizontal arc. The hitbox is calculated from the center of Ticks; this fact combined with the incredibly small hitbox, it is possible for a Tick to attach and be unable to do damage due to not being able to reach the player — especially if they are moving.
